name: Balance EQ Situations and Styles
author: Freek van Gool
description: Starting points for Balance EQ for mixing down and mastering in many music styles and situations: club, festival, big room, home hi-fi, headphones, studio reference, radio and car, plus 32 music styles for streaming. Every preset sets its own band frequencies, Q values and gains (a low shelf, three bells and a high shelf; gains stay within about 3.5 dB). A situation adds its own correction to the style, for example more low end for a club or a gentler top for headphones. The shelf and mid-bell Q values follow the style (broad and smooth for classical and ambient, tight for hardstyle and metal), and the dynamic bands (a cut in the lower and upper bell when that band gets loud) are switched on for dense styles, radio and headphones and left off for studio reference. Every preset stores its number of bands (5 here); a preset with up to 12 bands can add f6..f12, g6..g12 and q6..q12.
